title: Admin console
denied: This console is for platform administrators.

overview.intro: The whole platform at a glance, live from the database.
overview.revenueHint: From Paymob subscriptions, at the configured prices.

workspaces.statusSuspended: Its members can't open it. Its public cards stay online.
workspaces.suspendBody: Its members lose access to it until you reactivate it. Its public cards stay online.
workspaces.planHint: Sets the plan directly, without Paymob: for contracts, trials and corrections.
workspaces.ownerHint: If nobody has this email yet, an account is created with the name and password below. The current owner becomes an admin.
workspaces.deleteBody: Its members lose it and its cards, chips and forms go offline at once. It can be restored below for 30 days; then it is erased for good, with its cards, leads and files. A paid plan stops renewing now.

form.name: Workspace name
form.passwordHint: Share it with them safely; they can change it after signing in.
form.needPassword: Set a password of at least 8 characters.

deleted.hint: Each can be restored until the date shown. After it, the workspace is erased for good with its cards, leads, events and files, and its chips go back to stock.
deleted.restoreBody: Its members get it back as it was, and its published cards and chips work again. A plan that was cancelled stays cancelled.

people.suspendBody: They lose access to every workspace they belong to until you reactivate them.
people.reactivateBody: Their access to every workspace they belong to comes back.

form.name: Name
form.workspaceHint: A new workspace is created with them as its owner.
form.superAdminHint: Can open this console and every workspace. Give it only to your own team.
form.needPassword: Set a password of at least 8 characters.

people.twoStepHint: For someone who lost both their phone and their recovery codes. Confirm who they are first (from the email address on the account, and what they know about their workspace). They'll be told by email.
people.twoStepResetBody: They will sign in with their password alone until they set it up again. A workspace that requires it will ask them to. Only do this once you're sure who is asking.

jobs.intro: The platform's background work: webhook deliveries and automation runs, newest first.

chips.tapHint: Hold each chip to the back of the phone. Its serial number is read and recorded as platform stock — nothing is written to the chip. Only registered chips can be used by a customer.
chips.holdChip: Hold a chip to the phone…
chips.readError: Could not read that chip. Move it and try again.
chips.insecure: Reading chips needs a secure (HTTPS) page. Open the console over HTTPS, or on localhost, to register by tapping.
chips.unsupported: This browser can't read NFC. Use Chrome on Android, or switch to “Paste a list”.
chips.bulkHint: For stock that arrives with a UID list from the supplier — one UID per line. UIDs already on file are skipped.
chips.empty: No chips match this filter yet.
chips.soldToHint: While a workspace is set, only it can add these chips. Leave as open stock only if the buyer is not known yet — any workspace that learns the UID can claim open stock.
chips.allocateTitle: Assign an existing batch to a buyer
chips.allocateHint: For stock registered before it was sold. Chips a workspace has already claimed cannot be reassigned.
chips.deleteBody: It leaves the registry and can no longer be added to a workspace.
chips.blocked: Blocked chips can't be claimed or used.
